geometry.note: OpenStreetMap alone supports at most 'approximate' confidence; no numeric figure is available to test this building's footprint against.

method: Same OpenStreetMap way 232494549 as the SLAC collider experimental hall (SLD) feature: DMRadio-m3 is to be located in the building that formerly housed SLD (per the 2022 DMRadio-m3 detector paper). Drawn as a second, detector-linked feature over the identical shape, because a different sourced occupant uses this hall.
name: Collider Experimental Hall (CEH), Building 750 (DMRadio-m3)
notes: Location is sourced to the DMRadio-m3 detector paper ('DMRadio-m3 will be located in Building 750 at SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory, the former site of the SLD detector'), independent of and more specific than the DMRadio detector record's own sourced placement (the general SLAC Menlo Park campus point).

summary.plain: Building 750, the former SLD collider hall, now housing the DMRadio-m3 axion dark-matter search.
